settings.sync.queue_title.description: Heading of the queued-changes list on the web sync-status page (offline outbox items waiting to reach the server).

settings.sync.op_create.description: Operation label on a sync-queue row: the queued change creates a new record.

settings.sync.op_update.description: Operation label on a sync-queue row: the queued change edits an existing record.

settings.sync.op_delete.description: Operation label on a sync-queue row: the queued change deletes (tombstones) a record.

settings.sync.status_queued.description: Status chip on a sync-queue row that has not been tried yet or will be retried.

settings.sync.status_error.description: Status chip on a sync-queue row whose upload was rejected by the server (e.g. missing permission).

settings.sync.status_conflict.value: Overridden by a newer change from another device
settings.sync.status_conflict.description: Explanation on a sync-queue row that was dropped because the server copy was updated more recently (last-write-wins).

settings.sync.discard.description: Button on a failed sync-queue row: throw the queued change away instead of retrying it.

menu.members.edit_title.description: Dialog title when the owner edits an existing member's display name and permissions.

menu.members.revoke_confirm_title.description: Confirmation dialog title before revoking a member's access.

menu.members.revoke_confirm_message.value: {name} will lose access to this business right away.
menu.members.revoke_confirm_message.description: Confirmation dialog body before revoking a member. {name} is the member's display name.

menu.members.reactivate.description: Action on a revoked member: make the membership active again.

menu.members.saved.description: Snackbar shown after a member was added or updated successfully.

menu.members.save_failed.description: Snackbar shown when adding or updating a member failed (e.g. network or duplicate email).

settings.business.save_failed.description: Snackbar shown when saving the business profile failed.

menu.about.licenses_body_web.value: The web app is built with open-source software, including: Next.js and React (MIT), Material UI (MIT), Supabase JS (MIT), next-intl (MIT), pdf-lib (MIT), Dexie.js (Apache 2.0).
menu.about.licenses_body_web.description: Licenses note on the web About screen listing the open-source libraries the web app uses.

reports.range.from_label.description: Label of the start-date field in the custom date-range picker on web report pages.

reports.range.to_label.description: Label of the end-date field in the custom date-range picker on web report pages.

reports.export.download_csv.description: Button on web report pages that downloads the current report as a CSV file (web counterpart of the Android share action).
